## What's new

- **Game options button is the system menu again.** Tapping it always opens the native iOS menu, with or without a controller.
  - Without a controller it shows **•••**.
  - With a controller connected it shows the **Options** glyph instead. Pressing Options opens the navigable panel, because system menus can't be driven by a controller.

## Install
Download `Starlight.ipa` below and install it with [Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io) over your current version, using the same Bundle ID.
